rows.name: Cardiology
rows.lead: A round-the-clock cath lab, non-invasive diagnostics and a heart-failure clinic — under one roof, staffed by six consultants.
rows.intro_title: Every minute of a cardiac event is treated like one

intro_body.paragraph: Chest pain is triaged the moment it reaches our door. ECG within ten minutes, troponin at the bedside, and a cath lab team that is already gowning while the report prints.
Beyond emergencies, the department runs scheduled clinics for hypertension, arrhythmia, valve disease and post-bypass rehabilitation — so the care does not stop at discharge.

procedures.title: Primary Angioplasty
procedures.text: Emergency stenting for a heart attack in progress, available every hour of the year.

procedures.title: Coronary Angiography
procedures.text: Radial-access diagnostic imaging with same-day discharge for most patients.

procedures.title: Echocardiography
procedures.text: Transthoracic, transesophageal and stress echo reported by the consultant who scanned you.

procedures.title: Pacemaker Implantation
procedures.text: Single, dual-chamber and biventricular devices, with a lifelong follow-up clinic.

procedures.title: TMT & Holter
procedures.text: Treadmill testing and 24-hour rhythm monitoring booked within 48 hours.

procedures.title: Heart Failure Clinic
procedures.text: Weekly review, drug titration and fluid management to keep readmissions down.

rows.conditions_lead: If your symptom is on this list, book the cardiology clinic directly — you do not need a referral from another department first.

rows.name: Neuro Surgery
rows.lead: Microsurgery, neuro-navigation and a dedicated neuro ICU for brain, spine and nerve conditions.
rows.intro_title: Precision work, on the most delicate tissue there is

intro_body.paragraph: Neurosurgery leaves no margin for approximation. Every case is planned on thin-slice imaging, executed under the microscope and recovered in an ICU staffed by nurses trained only in neuro care.
Suspected stroke bypasses the queue entirely: CT within twenty minutes of arrival, thrombolysis decision made by the consultant on call.

badge.title: Stroke is time-critical
badge.text: Face drooping or slurred speech — come straight to Emergency.

procedures.title: Craniotomy
procedures.text: Tumour, haematoma and aneurysm surgery under the operating microscope.

procedures.title: Spinal Fusion
procedures.text: Instrumented fusion for instability, deformity and degenerative collapse.

procedures.title: Microdiscectomy
procedures.text: Keyhole removal of a herniated disc, most patients walking the same evening.

procedures.title: VP Shunt
procedures.text: Hydrocephalus management for infants and adults, with a programmable valve.

procedures.title: Nerve Decompression
procedures.text: Carpal tunnel, ulnar nerve and other entrapment releases as day surgery.

procedures.title: Head Injury Care
procedures.text: Trauma protocol from resuscitation through ICU to rehabilitation.

rows.conditions_lead: Brain, spine and peripheral nerve — assessed by the same team that will operate, if surgery turns out to be the answer.

rows.name: Orthopedics
rows.lead: Joint replacement, sports injury and trauma care — with physiotherapy starting the day after surgery.
rows.intro_title: The operation is half the job — walking again is the other half

intro_body.paragraph: A replaced joint only counts once it is being used. Physiotherapy is booked before surgery, starts the morning after it, and continues as an outpatient course until you are back to your own stairs.
Trauma is covered around the clock: fractures are plated or nailed the same admission wherever the soft tissue allows.

badge.title: Free gait assessment
badge.text: Walk-in screening every Saturday morning, no appointment.

procedures.title: Total Knee Replacement
procedures.text: Navigated implant positioning, with a rehabilitation plan agreed before admission.

procedures.title: Hip Replacement
procedures.text: Primary and revision arthroplasty using cemented or uncemented implants.

procedures.title: Arthroscopy
procedures.text: Keyhole ACL reconstruction, meniscus and rotator-cuff repair.

procedures.title: Fracture Fixation
procedures.text: Plating, nailing and external fixation for trauma of any complexity.

procedures.title: Hand & Wrist Surgery
procedures.text: Carpal tunnel release, tendon repair and small-joint reconstruction.

procedures.title: Pediatric Orthopedics
procedures.text: Club foot, growth-plate injury and limb deformity correction.

rows.conditions_lead: Bone, joint, ligament and tendon — from a weekend sports tear to decades of wear.

rows.name: General Surgery
rows.lead: Keyhole surgery for gallbladder, hernia and appendix — smaller scars, shorter stays.
rows.intro_title: Keyhole wherever keyhole is the right answer

intro_body.paragraph: Laparoscopic surgery is the default here, not an upgrade. Three small incisions instead of one long one means less pain, a lower infection risk and most patients home inside two days.
Open surgery is still the correct choice for some cases, and we will say so plainly rather than convert halfway through for the sake of the brochure.

badge.title: Home in two days
badge.text: Typical stay for a keyhole gallbladder removal.

procedures.title: Laparoscopic Cholecystectomy
procedures.text: Keyhole gallbladder removal, usually discharged the next morning.

procedures.title: Hernia Repair
procedures.text: Mesh repair for inguinal, umbilical and incisional hernias.

procedures.title: Appendicectomy
procedures.text: Emergency keyhole appendix removal, theatre available at any hour.

procedures.title: Piles & Fistula Surgery
procedures.text: Stapler haemorrhoidopexy and fistula procedures as day cases.

procedures.title: Breast Lump Surgery
procedures.text: Biopsy, lumpectomy and mastectomy with oncology coordination.

procedures.title: Wound & Abscess Care
procedures.text: Drainage, debridement and diabetic-foot wound management.

rows.conditions_lead: Abdominal pain that will not settle deserves a surgical opinion — not another course of antacids.

rows.name: Pediatric Surgery
rows.lead: Surgery for newborns, infants and children — in a ward built for parents to stay overnight.

intro_body.paragraph: Doses, instruments, anaesthesia and recovery all work differently in a four-year-old. The pediatric theatre list is staffed by anaesthetists who work with children every week, not occasionally.
A parent stays with the child throughout, including into the anaesthetic room. Preparation is done with picture books and play rather than a consent form pushed across a desk.

badge.title: You stay with them
badge.text: Right into the anaesthetic room — no exceptions asked for.

procedures.title: Hernia & Hydrocele
procedures.text: The commonest childhood operation, done as a day case.

procedures.title: Appendicectomy
procedures.text: Emergency keyhole surgery for children with appendicitis.

procedures.title: Neonatal Surgery
procedures.text: Correction of congenital defects in the first weeks of life.

procedures.title: Undescended Testis
procedures.text: Orchidopexy timed to protect future fertility.

procedures.title: Circumcision
procedures.text: Medical circumcision under short general anaesthesia.

procedures.title: Pediatric Trauma
procedures.text: Fractures and injuries managed with growth plates in mind.

rows.conditions_lead: If you are unsure whether something needs surgery at all, book the clinic — most visits end with reassurance.

rows.name: Prenatal Care
rows.lead: From the first scan to the first feed — one team, one file, and a labour room that never closes.
rows.intro_title: Nine months of care from the same faces

intro_body.paragraph: Continuity matters more in maternity than almost anywhere else. The consultant who confirms the pregnancy runs the growth scans, writes the birth plan and is called when labour starts.
A birth companion is welcome in the labour room. Ante-natal classes run every second Saturday and cover breathing, feeding and what the first fortnight at home is actually like.

checks.text: Growth and anomaly scans on site

badge.title: Labour room open 24/7
badge.text: Come in at any hour — no appointment needed in labour.

procedures.text: A full schedule of visits, bloods and scans mapped out at your first appointment.

procedures.title: Ultrasound & Doppler
procedures.text: Dating, anomaly and growth scans reported by the obstetrician who sees you.

procedures.title: Normal Delivery
procedures.text: Midwife-led birth with consultant cover, in a private labour room.

procedures.title: Caesarean Section
procedures.text: Planned or emergency, with skin-to-skin contact in theatre wherever possible.

rows.conditions_title: What the maternity team looks after

rows.name: Nephrology
rows.lead: General internal medicine alongside a 16-station dialysis unit, running three shifts a day.
rows.intro_title: Chronic care that fits around a working life

intro_body.paragraph: Dialysis is not a one-off event, it is a schedule someone lives with for years. We run early-morning, afternoon and evening shifts so treatment can sit around a job rather than replace it.
The general medicine side handles diabetes, thyroid, infection and the long tail of conditions that do not belong to any single organ specialty.

badge.title: Regular slot guaranteed
badge.text: Fixed weekly chair times for every long-term patient.

procedures.text: Bicarbonate dialysis on reverse-osmosis water, with single-use dialysers on request.

procedures.title: Peritoneal Dialysis
procedures.text: Home-based CAPD, including catheter insertion and family training.

procedures.text: Ultrasound-guided biopsy with same-day histopathology dispatch.

procedures.title: AV Fistula Surgery

procedures.text: HbA1c-led review, insulin titration and foot screening in one visit.

procedures.text: Fever, infection, thyroid, anaemia — the everyday work of a physician.

rows.conditions_lead: Kidney disease rarely arrives alone. The physicians and nephrologists share a floor so a single visit covers both.

rows.name: Ophthalmology
rows.lead: Cataract, glaucoma and retina care with a dedicated eye theatre and same-day discharge.

intro_body.paragraph: A routine cataract is admitted, operated and discharged the same day. Phacoemulsification through a two-millimetre incision means no stitches and, for most people, reading vision back within the week.
The department also screens every diabetic patient in the hospital for retinopathy — catching damage while it is still reversible.

badge.title: Diabetic? Screen yearly.
badge.text: Free retina screening with any diabetes review.

procedures.title: Cataract Surgery
procedures.text: Stitchless phaco with a foldable intraocular lens, discharged the same day.

procedures.title: Glaucoma Management
procedures.text: Pressure monitoring, field testing and trabeculectomy when drops stop working.

procedures.title: Retinal Laser
procedures.text: Photocoagulation for diabetic retinopathy and retinal tears.

procedures.title: Refraction & Optometry

rows.conditions_lead: Sudden loss of vision is an emergency — come to the department the same day, not at your next appointment.

rows.name: Dental Care
rows.lead: Preventive, restorative and surgical dentistry — including implants and wisdom-tooth removal under sedation.

intro_body.paragraph: Most people put off dental care because of what they expect it to feel like. Local anaesthesia is given time to work, sedation is offered for longer procedures, and nothing starts before you have seen the plan and the price.
The clinic is inside the hospital, so patients on blood thinners or with cardiac history are treated with the relevant specialist a corridor away.

checks.text: Root canal in a single sitting

badge.title: Free first check-up
badge.text: Screening and OPG at no charge every first Monday.

rows.name: Lab & Diagnostics
rows.lead: Pathology, radiology and imaging in one block — most reports back the same day, delivered to your phone.
rows.intro_title: A result you can act on before the day is out

intro_body.paragraph: Waiting three days for a blood report delays every decision that depends on it. Routine biochemistry and haematology are released within six hours, and critical values are phoned to the treating doctor immediately.
Samples can be collected at home for anyone within eight kilometres — useful for elderly patients and anyone on a dialysis schedule.

badge.title: Reports on your phone
badge.text: Delivered by WhatsApp the moment they are verified.

procedures.title: Haematology

rows.name: Nutrition
rows.lead: Clinical dietetics for inpatients and a weight, diabetes and child-growth clinic for everyone else.
rows.intro_title: A diet plan you can actually cook at home

intro_body.paragraph: A plan written around foods nobody in the household eats gets abandoned in a week. Ours are built from what is already in your kitchen, priced for your budget and written in the language you read most easily.
Inpatients are seen on the ward daily — renal, cardiac, diabetic and post-surgical diets are prepared in the hospital kitchen rather than outsourced.

badge.title: Free BMI screening
badge.text: Walk in any weekday between 10 AM and 12 noon.

procedures.title: Weight Management
procedures.text: Measured, gradual plans with fortnightly review — no crash protocols.

procedures.text: Carbohydrate counting matched to your insulin or tablet schedule.
